example.title: Two-storey motel with open galleries (Mammoth Lakes)

brief: A 1970s two-storey motor inn: a long I-plan block of white-painted walls with rows of blue room doors and windows off a continuous open gallery on the upper floor, a plain steel gallery rail, a low hipped brown roof, a big asphalt car park in front. Two photos (2018). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
